root_cause_label: Wrong path and missing content in single-step task
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent created an empty file at /hello.txt instead of writing 'Hello, world!' to /app/hello.txt, violating both the path and content requirements of the task.
t_err_evidence: Step 1: agent runs '[edit /hello.txt] create' — wrong path (/ instead of /app/) and no content written; terminal confirms 'File created successfully at: /hello.txt'.
t_commit_evidence: The single and only step creates the wrong file with no content; the agent then terminates, locking in the failure immediately.
t_surface_evidence: Terminal output 'File created successfully at: /hello.txt' confirms the file was placed at the wrong path; no content written.
trigger_explanation: The agent never read or correctly applied the task specification: it used the wrong output path (/hello.txt vs /app/hello.txt) and skipped writing the required 'Hello, world!' content entirely, then immediately stopped.
